name: devai-plan
description: Turn repository evidence and intent into a bounded DEVAI implementation plan (change, init, or module) without mutating the repository. Use when explicitly asked to plan before implementing; not a required step before every change.

change.description: Plan a bounded code or documentation change from current evidence.

init.description: Preview initialization changes through the deterministic initializer.

module.description: Plan a module from explicit requirements and discovered repository structure.
